hook: Raat teen baje Rohan ne apni hi awaaz suni...
hook_text: PG gate par Papa ka dabba?
feedback: Solid, punchy script with an exceptionally strong Gen-Z urban horror premise (voice cloning + late-night delivery). Cuts 1-2 nail the flash-forward hook. To elevate it further: In Cut 4, deepen Rohan's emotional vulnerability in just 4-5 words (e.g., mention missing home-cooked food or surviving on cup noodles) so Papa's tiffin delivery feels emotionally loaded rather than purely functional. Cut 11's dialogue '...voice hack kar li hai' sounds slightly clinical/expository; make it more frantic and colloquial like 'Rohan! Gate mat kholna, maine koi dabba nahi bheja, wo meri awaaz nahi hai!' Fina
lines: Raat teen baje Rohan ne apni hi awaaz suni...
Lekin wo awaaz gate ke andar se aa rahi thi.
Bengaluru ke Koramangala mein moosladhaar baarish ho rahi thi.
Akele PG room mein Rohan ka phone baja... Bhopal se Papa ki call thi.
Papa bole, 'Beta, gate par delivery aayi hai, guard so raha hai khud le le.'
Rohan phone ki flashlight jalakar andheri seedhiyon se neeche utra.
Lohe ke gate ke paar peela raincoat pehne ek insaan khada tha.
Haath mein steel ka tiffin... par chehra bilkul gayab.
Jaise hi Rohan ne gate kholne ke liye haath badhaya...
Rohan! Gate mat kholna, kisi ne meri voice hack kar li hai!
Rohan ke haath se phone fisalkar zameen par ja gira.
Peeche mudte hi bhaari lohe ki kundi band hone ki khanak goonji.
Raat teen baje anjaan delivery ka darwaza kabhi mat kholna... kya pata wo andar aa chuka ho?
